final_text:
COMMAND: claude -p "<PROMPT>" --model claude-haiku-5-5 --output-format stream-json --verbose --bare --disable-slash-commands --strict-mcp-config --tools "Read,Grep,Glob" --allowedTools "Read,Grep,Glob" --permission-mode dontAsk --no-session-persistence

EXCLUDES:
- `-p`: non-interactive, so no prompts or interactive session.
- `--bare`: skips CLAUDE.md discovery (project and user), auto-memory, hooks, plugins, and keychain reads.
- `--disable-slash-commands`: disables all Skills, including user-level ones.
- `--strict-mcp-config` (no `--mcp-config`): ignores MCP servers from `.mcp.json` and user config.
- `--tools` and `--allowedTools`: leave only Read, Grep, and Glob; no Bash, Write, Edit, web, or agent tools.
- `--permission-mode dontAsk`: anything not pre-approved is denied instead of prompted.
- `--no-session-persistence`: no saved transcript to resume.

RESIDUAL:
- Reads outside the working directory: Read, Grep, and Glob accept absolute paths. `dontAsk` should deny out-of-directory access, but I have not verified this. The arm could still read the knowledge directory if it does not. Test with a canary file outside the cwd before use.
- The model's pretrained knowledge and the prompt text itself.

SOURCE_CHECK:
- The cwd (`...\D2-treatment-T3\cwd`) was globbed for CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .mcp.json, and AGENTS.md. Nothing was found, so no repository instructions need excluding there.
- I did not consult the knowledge store, since it is what the arm must not reach and does not bear on the flags.
- I have no shell tool, so I could not run `claude --help`. The flag names and `dontAsk` mode come from my knowledge of the CLI and are unverified against this installed version.
